slug: 2025-05-20 African nations making digital ID gains in the face of common challenges (ID4Africa 2025)

facts.fact: The Houwiyeti digital ID and digital-government platform, launched in 2023, handles 70 percent of passport requests, per the ANRPTS director at ID4Africa 2025.
Houwiyeti is used for passport requests and for more than 622,000 document extracts processed in the year.
